messages:
leah: Thanks for the briefing today. A few follow-ups on compliance stuff from customers + partners: (a) exact SOC2/ISO milestones and when we can share an evidence checklist, (b) VPC private control planenetworking specifics (cross-account peering, private endpoints), (c) audit log fields and retention for hosted vs private, and (d) BYOK key rotation semantics. Who can give short answers and owners?

sec_bot: Uploaded the compliance slide deck and trackers: https://handbook.redwood.com/security/compliance-tracker. Also created an office-hours poll: https://cal.com/redwood/security-qna (please vote).

mohit: Quick summary from security: SOC2 Type II audit window target = Oct-Nov 2026; controls must be in place by Aug 2026. ISO 27001 readiness assessment scheduled Jul 2026; certification target H1 2027. We will publish a checklist of evidence types next week.

tess: Logging/infra note: audit log v1 contains model_name, model_version, request_id, route, token_in, token_out, latency_ms, and actor_id. Hosted: audit UI shows redacted prompt_text and 90-day retention by default. Private: full payloads can be exported to customer buckets; retention controlled by customer. Example event: ```{"ts":"2026-07-14T09:21:00Z","model_name":"redwood-13b","model_version":"v2.0","request_id":"req_0XYZ","token_in":10}```.

infra_riley: Regarding networking: private control plane supports VPC endpoints and cross-account peering in beta. For cross-account peering we require IAM role trust and a peering connector; detailed checklist will be in the beta docs. Latency across regions is subject to standard inter-region egress.

eva: BYOK specifics: Private already supports customer-managed KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure). We use envelope encryption; rotating the customer KMS key is supported but requires a rotation workflow: 1) upload new key version in KMS, 2) call our rotate-keys API, 3) re-encrypt short-lived envelopes. We'll publish a step-by-step. HSM-level BYOK (FIPS/HSM) is on the roadmap for limited alpha in Q4 2026.

leah: Two clarifying Qs: 1) Will audit logs include raw prompt text if a hosted customer opts in? 2) For SOC2 evidence, will we share auditor contact or only summarized reports?

mohit: Hosted opt-in: yes, customers can enable full-text audit exports but only after explicit consent in Console and with Data Retention settings; we warn about PII/privacy and compliance. SOC2: we'll publish the auditor name and a SOC2 summary report; raw auditor communications remain internal.

tess: Action items I heard: (A) Post audit-log schema + example exports (owner: @tess), (B) Publish VPC beta networking checklist (owner: @infra_riley), (C) Publish SOC2 evidence checklist + timeline (owner: @mohit), (D) Draft BYOK rotation guide and HSM roadmap (owner: @eva). I'll assemble a short FAQ for customers and sales.

sec_bot: Tasks created: [audit-log-schema], [vpc-beta-networking], [soc2-evidence-checklist], [byok-rotation-guide]. Will ping owners tomorrow at 10:00 UTC.

leah: Great, thanks. Can we also get a 1-page 'customer-ready' summary for solutions/sales to use now? Short bullets only. @tess please coordinate with product.

infra_riley: Will do. Also note: early access to VPC beta requires signing a beta agreement; DM me if you have candidates.

leah: Closing loop thanks folks. We'll review progress in the next all-hands and in the office hours.
